title: EPILOGUE // THE EXILE'S PACT
narrative: Cersei boards a swift galley bound for Pentos, Tommen clutched tightly to her chest. She watches King's Landing dwindle into the mist, her crown surrendered, but her child alive. In Essos, golden dragons will buy wine and safety, far from the throne that devoured her family.
